method: Scanned titles/bodies of all 2578 merged PRs plus linked issue text for later regression/introduced-by/follow-up references to small PRs, then read both diffs and mapped post-image lines from the introducing PR patch hunks (all lines in range verified as added). Clean cases are small PRs merged 2026-06-01..09-15 with no later PR/issue text referencing them (GitHub search plus regex verification), skimmed for visible defects.

cases.title: fix(#481): remove residual dead silent-expiry poll helper + Atomics.wait in bug-1974

fix.quote: Re-adds the guard removed in #482. Refs #490. (restore bounded Windows EBUSY cleanup retry in afterEach)

cases.note: #482 removed the afterEach outer retry guard; #493 restored it after Windows EBUSY made next red.

cases.title: fix(#2018): applySurface empty manifest no longer deletes gsd-* agents

fix.quote: Fixes a `lint-tests` failure on `next` introduced by #2031 (#2018): the regression test ... used raw `fs.rmSync()` in `afterEach`

cases.note: Raw fs.rmSync in test afterEach tripped local/no-raw-rmsync-in-tests; fix swaps to helpers.cleanup.

cases.title: fix(#3582): stop the cold-tree fixture racing concurrent hook builds

fix.quote: This is a follow-up to #3656, fixing a defect in the guard that PR added.

cases.note: Post-snapshot raw readdir comparison of shared hooks/ raced concurrent build-hooks staging dir; fix filters both snapshots.

cases.title: fix(#5627): look through wrapper options in the secret-read guard

fix.quote: The secret-read guard's `WRAPPERS` table (added in #5685) left out three value-taking options that sudo(8) and doas(1) document

cases.note: WRAPPERS table omits sudo -a/-c and doas -a so option value is read as command word (guard fails open).

cases.title: fix(#4010): confine stateReplaceField to same-line whitespace so an empty field's following line survives

fix.quote: #4010 (PR #4021) narrowed this pattern's label-to-value gap to same-line whitespace but did not anchor it

cases.note: boldPattern left unanchored, so a quoted bold label mid-prose is rewritten and the rest of the line destroyed.

cases.title: fix(#3990): state the RED/GREEN/REFACTOR cycle once, embed tdd.md conditionally

fix.quote: both executor dispatch backends previously referenced an unassigned `${TDD_APPLICABLE}` placeholder

cases.note: TDD_APPLICABLE is used but never assigned in either backend; tdd.md embed silently dropped (issue #4264: Introduced by #4228).

cases.title: fix(#4854): init verbs emit the ROADMAP display name, not the directory slug

fix.quote: `roadmap get-phase` and every init verb's `phase_name` kept the `(INSERTED)` marker that `phase insert` writes into the heading

cases.note: resolvePhaseDisplayName prefers raw ROADMAP heading name, which keeps the (INSERTED) marker (issue #5824: carried since #5363).

cases.title: ci(#6073): re-run Tests when fix-next is added or removed

fix.quote: #6074 added `labeled`/`unlabeled` to the Tests `pull_request` trigger. Every label change started a full Tests run and cancelled the run in progress

cases.note: Adding labeled/unlabeled to pull_request types makes every label event cancel in-flight Tests runs.

cases.title: Enhancement(#41): /gsd-ship extracts per-commit gate_status into a PR-body TDD Audit + squash trailer

fix.quote: PR #585 shipped the consumer/extraction logic and assumed commits would carry `gate_status:` trailers.

cases.note: Step 8 reads gate_status trailers nothing writes, so every commit counts missing and the TDD Audit table is noise.

cases.title: fix(#1498): regenerate capability-registry.cjs in npm version lifecycle hook

fix.quote: The `npm version` lifecycle hook (added in #1499) runs `gen-capability-registry.cjs --write`, which requires ... a gitignored `build:lib` / `tsc` output artifact.

cases.note: version script depends on unbuilt gitignored output; release workflow ran npm version before build:lib.

cases.title: fix(3805): schema-aware log_to_state row appending in fast.md

fix.quote: `/gsd-fast`'s `log_to_state` step has never appended a Quick Task row to `STATE.md` since PR #85.

cases.note: awk NF-1 over-counts columns by one so the -eq 5 gate is unsatisfiable.

cases.title: fix(#2969): ratchet completed_plans up for gap-closure plans under deriveProgressKeys

fix.quote: compared counters with `typeof x === 'number'`. Parsed frontmatter scalars are strings, so both sides were `-Infinity` and the stored value always won

cases.note: Ratchet-up comparison never fires on string frontmatter values (issue #5619: makes the #2969 ratchet unreachable).

cases.title: ci: run affected tests in PR workflow lanes

fix.quote: PR #366 (ci #365) switched PR lanes to `npm run test:affected` with no suite scoping. `affected-tests-lib.cjs` had no install/slow exclusion

cases.note: Smoke fallback selects the install tarball test on PR lanes (Windows failed); install/slow suites not excluded.

cases.title: fix(#3968): measure commit claims at all three surfaces — ledger, verifier BLOCKER, porcelain HANDOFF

fix.quote: measured `plan_head_before..HEAD` — verify-time HEAD. That window grows with every later plan's task and SUMMARY commits

cases.note: ACTUAL commit count measured to verify-time HEAD flags honest plans as commit_claim_mismatch (issue #4670: introduced by #3968/#4230).
